description: This file defines the internal API map handling for TensorFlow's Go bindings, including creation, update, and retrieval of API definitions for TensorFlow operations.
external_files: C header includes: stdlib.h, string.h, tensorflow/c/c_api.h

classes.name: apiDefMap
classes.description: Encapsulates a collection of API definitions, providing methods to create, update, and retrieve API definitions.

methods.name: newAPIDefMap
methods.description: Creates and returns a new apiDefMap instance from an OpList protobuf.

methods.name: (*apiDefMap).Put
methods.description: Updates apiDefMap with new API definitions provided as a serialized text proto string.

methods.name: (*apiDefMap).Get
methods.description: Retrieves the ApiDef protobuf for a specific operation name, deserializing from internal C buffer.
